cli.hub_shared_help.publish_yes.tone: terse, operator-facing, preserves safety and consent distinctions
cli.hub_shared_help.publish_yes.note: Shared agents/teams push --yes/-y: skips confirmation prompts but does not accept unresolved preview values. Preserve --accept-unresolved as the separate explicit consent flag.

cli.hub_shared_help.publish_preview_only.note: Shared push --preview-only prints a diff without publishing. Preserve exit 2 specifically when the preview would generalize a value.

cli.hub_shared_help.publish_json.note: Shared push --json preview includes reference values and a single-use commit pin; preserve the warning that this machine-readable output is sensitive.

cli.hub_shared_help.publish_accept_unres.note: Shared push --accept-unresolved explicitly acknowledges all unclassifiable preview values and publishes those values unchanged; preserve the consent meaning.

cli.hub_shared_help.publish_allow_intern.note: Shared push --allow-internal-ops consents to an organization-publish allowance; requires the literal --org flag and displays consent text interactively.

cli.hub_shared_help.sync_check.note: Shared sync --check is report-only and must not change anything.

cli.hub_shared_help.sync_prefer.note: Shared sync --prefer chooses the winner only for conflicting sections changed on both sides. Command choices local/remote remain parser tokens, not translated prose.

cli.hub_shared_help.sync_accept_unknown_.note: Shared sync --accept-unknown-baseline applies hub additions when ancestry is unknown without removing the local copy contents. Preserve the no-loss promise.

cli.hub_shared_help.sync_replace.note: Shared sync --replace discards the local copy for the hub version; keep strong DISCARD emphasis and the literal --yes requirement.

cli.hub_shared_help.sync_yes.note: Shared sync --yes confirms the destructive --replace operation; preserve the flag token.

cli.hub_shared_help.sync_dry_run.note: Shared sync --dry-run reports prospective changes and writes no agent rows; preserve this no-write promise for both callers.
